scope: Exploratory local simulation only; not a theorem proof, confirmatory FDR/SupFDR calibration, Rust benchmark, or SOTA comparison.
execution_note: Reported values came from a separate local Python reimplementation of the committed pilot logic, using the same Bernoulli LR factors, downward A2 rounding, finite-envelope weights, exact closure deficit, scenario definitions and deterministic seed schedule. The checked-in pilot runner itself has not been executed from a connected checkout.

configuration.null_lr_factors: 7/5 on success; 3/5 on failure; conditional expectation exactly 1
configuration.arrival_contract: Predictable fixed roster of 24 candidates; late-cluster candidates 16..23 activate at look 20.

other_scenarios.all_null: No discoveries observed for ordinary or anchored methods in the 100-stream cells.
other_scenarios.sparse_strong: No additional discoveries observed from anchoring.
other_scenarios.dense_weak: No additional discoveries observed from anchoring.
other_scenarios.switching: No additional discoveries observed from anchoring.

error_rate_observations.interpretation: Zero observed false discoveries in this pilot is not evidence of error-rate calibration or control.

uncertainty.interpretation: Observed 0.1-0.3 percentage-point power differences are much smaller than the uncertainty bound.

claim_boundary: The finite-envelope anchor retains the unscaled weights within the precommitted 24-candidate universe.
The observed power differences are exploratory and do not establish improvement.
No statistical superiority, SOTA, Rust execution, or CI result is claimed.
